description: First app-level set, authored 2026-11-17 AFTER the app gained everyday-wording interpretation (src/interpret.py), growth/share/period analysis (src/analysis.py), the measure-name check, six years of data (2021-2026) and rescaled targets, and committed before any run on it. Each question goes through the full StructuredPlanningAgent exactly as in the app (current Admin settings), and the final answer table is compared by VALUES with a hand-written reference DAX query (column names are ignored; percentages shown with one decimal are accepted within 0.06 percentage points). Modes: rows = same rows in any order; top1 = the first answer row matches the first reference row (ranking questions). Unsupported cases pass when the app declines without running a query. Relative dates are read as of the as_of date. All questions were written by the developer, who also wrote the rules being tested, so the set is biased towards wording the rules know.

cases.question: How much money did each branch make?
Which shops perform best?
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('DimStore'[StoreName], "N", [Net Sales]) ORDER BY [N] DESC

cases.question: Net sales by month of the year
Which store grew the most between 2021 and 2026?
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES('DimStore'[StoreName]), "A", CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2021), "B", CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2026), "C", CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2026) - CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2021), "P", DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2026) - CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2021), CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2021))) ORDER BY [P] DESC

cases.question: Net sales growth year over year
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES('DimDate'[Year]), "N", [Net Sales], "C", VAR y = 'DimDate'[Year] VAR prev = CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = y - 1) RETURN IF(ISBLANK(prev), BLANK(), [Net Sales] - prev), "P", VAR y = 'DimDate'[Year] VAR prev = CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'DimDate'[Year] = y - 1) RETURN IF(ISBLANK(prev), BLANK(), DIVIDE([Net Sales] - prev, prev)))

cases.question: How did units sold change between 2023 and 2026 by category?
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES('DimProduct'[Category]), "A", CALCULATE([Units Sold], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2023), "B", CALCULATE([Units Sold], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2026), "C", CALCULATE([Units Sold], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2026) - CALCULATE([Units Sold], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2023), "P", DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Units Sold], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2026) - CALCULATE([Units Sold], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2023), CALCULATE([Units Sold], 'DimDate'[Year] = 2023)))

cases.question: Delivery share of net sales by year
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES('DimDate'[Year]), "Ch", "Delivery", "N", CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'FactSales'[Channel] = "Delivery"), "S", DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'FactSales'[Channel] = "Delivery"), [Net Sales]))

cases.question: Share of net sales by channel
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES('FactSales'[Channel]), "N", [Net Sales], "S", DIVIDE([Net Sales], CALCULATE([Net Sales], ALL('FactSales'[Channel]))))

cases.question: Gross profit by category during White Friday 2025
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('DimProduct'[Category], FILTER(ALL('DimDate'[Date]), 'DimDate'[Date] >= DATE(2025, 11, 28) && 'DimDate'[Date] <= DATE(2025, 11, 30)), "G", [Gross Profit])

cases.question: Cash share of net sales by region
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES('DimStore'[Region]), "M", "Cash", "N", CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'FactSales'[PaymentMethod] = "Cash"), "S", DIVIDE(CALCULATE([Net Sales], 'FactSales'[PaymentMethod] = "Cash"), [Net Sales]))

cases.question: Sales target vs net sales by region in 2025
Which category missed its target the most in 2026?
cases.reference_dax: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('DimProduct'[Category], TREATAS({2026}, 'DimDate'[Year]), "A", [Target Achievement %]) ORDER BY [A] ASC
